query: Plan a Suppliers detail screen. The loaded project instructions declare `.resonance/apps/console-design.md` as the console app source. Its approved default says equivalent workspace record inspection uses the existing contextual drawer; a route is approved for the named full-record editor. Customers uses the drawer. An internal query-index change is also in the request and has no visible effect. The project has a second marketing app with its own design source.
expected_behavior: Uses the explicit console app declaration before `.resonance/05_design.md` or local discovery and reads only applicable rules and references
Plans Suppliers inspection using the approved drawer default or names an explicitly approved variant; does not treat the editor route as a general exception
Keeps the marketing app's separate design source scoped to that app
Skips design-contract work for the internal query-index change because it has no user-visible effect
Does not require a new approval for ordinary reuse or invent a new product-wide rule
